build_hierarchical_recurrent_encoder: build a hierarchical recurrent encoder that encodes utterances with word embeddings and dialog context using nested LSTMs
create_hierarchical_recurrent_encoder_in: create a HierarchicalRecurrentEncoder instance with vocab_size, word_embed_size, hidden_size, and num_layers params
run_hierarchical_recurrent_encoder_forwa: run the encoder forward pass on a batch dict containing user_utt, user_utt_len, and dialog_len tensors
register_hierarchical_recurrent_encoder: register the HierarchicalRecurrentEncoder class as a named encoder via the encoders.register_encoder decorator
get_encoder_hidden_states_and_dialog_con: get encoder hidden states and dialog context outputs from the forward pass of the hierarchical recurrent encoder
